import math

# Extract budget expenditures from March 1942 to October 1948
# Values are in millions of dollars

# 1942: Mar to Dec
expenditures_1942 = {
    'Mar': 3515, 'Apr': 3939, 'May': 4100, 'Jun': 4810,
    'Jul': 5257, 'Aug': 5456, 'Sep': 5921, 'Oct': 6184,

}

# 1943: Jan to Dec
expenditures_1943 = {
    'Jan': 6728, 'Feb': 6358, 'Mar': 7746, 'Apr': 7300,
    'May': 7475, 'Jun': 8260, 'Jul': 7499, 'Aug': 7831,
    'Sep': 7667, 'Oct': 7619, 'Nov': 7947, 'Dec': 7744
}

# 1944: Jan to Dec
expenditures_1944 = {
    'Jan': 7737, 'Feb': 8012, 'Mar': 10412, 'Apr': 7337,
    'May': 6879, 'Jun': 8631, 'Jul': 8014, 'Aug': 8208,
    'Sep': 7779, 'Oct': 8034, 'Nov': 7811, 'Dec': 8327
}

# 1945: Jan to Dec
expenditures_1945 = {
    'Jan': 8142, 'Feb': 7127, 'Mar': 9034, 'Apr': 7758,
    'May': 8927, 'Jun': 9540, 'Jul': 8561, 'Aug': 6949,
    'Sep': 6372, 'Oct': 5619, 'Nov': 4530, 'Dec': 4962
}

# 1946: Jan to Dec
expenditures_1946 = {
    'Jan': 4811, 'Feb': 3340, 'Mar': 3598, 'Apr': 3750,
    'May': 3374, 'Jun': 4836, 'Jul': 3287, 'Aug': 2745,
    'Sep': 2663, 'Oct': 2860, 'Nov': 2453, 'Dec': 3605
}

# 1947: Jan to Dec
expenditures_1947 = {
    'Jan': 3019, 'Feb': 3731, 'Mar': 3239, 'Apr': 3407,
    'May': 3284, 'Jun': 4996, 'Jul': 3553, 'Aug': 2962,
    'Sep': 2673, 'Oct': 2394, 'Nov': 2113, 'Dec': 3176
}

# 1948: Jan to Oct
expenditures_1948 = {
    'Jan': 2800, 'Feb': 2224, 'Mar': 3086, 'Apr': 2541,
    'May': 2222, 'Jun': 7018, 'Jul': 3558, 'Aug': 2143,
    'Sep': 2869, 'Oct': 2685
}

# Combine all values
all_values = (
    list(expenditures_1942.values()) +
    list(expenditures_1943.values()) +
    list(expenditures_1944.values()) +
    list(expenditures_1945.values()) +
    list(expenditures_1946.values()) +
    list(expenditures_1947.values()) +
    list(expenditures_1948.values())
)

print(f"Number of monthly values: {len(all_values)}")
print(f"Values: {all_values}")

# Calculate geometric mean
# GM = (product of all values)^(1/n)
log_sum = sum(math.log(x) for x in all_values)
geometric_mean = math.exp(log_sum / len(all_values))

print(f"\nGeometric mean: {geometric_mean}")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {round(geometric_mean, 2)}")
